Emit a fixed scalar value on every simulation tick.

GraphExecutor owns this bounded scalar source. It is not a trainable parameter or a PipelineExecutor Tensor source.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Utility](../categories/utility.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Search words | constant, value, simulation, scalar |

## Inputs

None: the node starts a branch of the graph.

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Value** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Scalar simulation value |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Signal | Value | `value` | Number | `1.0` |   | The run | Finite scalar output. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: Constant belongs to the GraphExecutor scalar simulation lane; PipelineExecutor does not execute simulation sources |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Support

| Aspect | Value | Supported | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Runtime | fail closed | No | Constant belongs to the GraphExecutor scalar simulation lane; PipelineExecutor does not execute simulation sources |
| Fail Mode | hard fail | No | As above |
| Pipeline Executor | unsupported | No | As above |
| Materializer | none | No | As above |
| Implementation Owner | graph executor | Yes | GraphExecutor owns bounded scalar control evaluation for the live simulation lane; PipelineExecutor and the training backend reject it. |
| Support State | real | Yes | As above |
| Workflow Lane | simulation | Yes | As above |
| Simulation Runtime | supported | Yes | As above |
